page.overview:
What is Hastalyk?

Hastalÿk is a Great Old One in the Cthulhu Mythos. Its only appearance is in Chaosium's supplement Malleus Monstrorum for their Call of Cthulhu RPG.

Hastalÿk is a gestalt entity composed of millions of microbial parts. It sweeps from planet to planet, amplifying and altering existing contagions as well as causing cellular mutations. It is neither a disease nor carry any disease, but a "mutating force" that forces native species to mutate uncontrollably, enabling diseases to spread throughout the planet.

Humans who caught a disease mutated by Hastalÿk may experience delusional fevers or fevered visions and dreams about other cosmic horrors. In rare cases, their body and voice may be possessed and controlled by Hastalÿk or another Old One.

Not much fact is known about Hastalÿk, only conjectures from scholars and scientists. Whether the mutation and spreading of disease are its goal or only side effects of its presence, as well as whether it moves throughout the galaxy or actually spreads itself on all worlds while remaining dormant on most, are highly contentious. A few scholars even suggest that Hastalÿk's consciousness may be active in many locations at once with varying scopes, thereby causing either global or only local outbreaks.
